what_this_is: For each screen, the filter columns its own filter combo offers, with the label the operator reads, the column name the query uses, and the data type. Read out of the client store; no filter was applied and no request was issued.
keyed_by: screen hash, because 22 operational labels are shared by more than one screen (seven screens are called "Work Queue")
caution: The column names here are what THIS screen puts in a query. They are not guaranteed to match the JSON keys of the resource the screen reads: on Inventory, the label "LPN" maps to loadNumber while structuredInventory answers to lpn.
